furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.effect: +100 heat cap, room for 4 more Jans and 5% more heat per Wood per level. Bigger fires draw bigger animals.

lumberYard.name: Lumber Yard
lumberYard.effect: +15% Chopping and +50 Wood storage per level.

huntingLodge.name: Hunting Lodge
huntingLodge.effect: +15% Hunting per level. Food is stored here.

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.effect: Wood, Food and Materials storage ×1.25 per level.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.effect: Jans eat 5% less per level. Chef Jans start turning up.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.effect: Opens the Building job (Materials); +20% per level.

researchHut.name: Research Hut
researchHut.effect: Opens the Research job (Knowledge); +20% per level. Spreadsheet Jans start turning up.

bunkhouse.name: Bunkhouse
bunkhouse.effect: Room for 2 more Jans per level.

expeditionPost.name: Expedition Post
expeditionPost.effect: Opens Scavenging; bursts come 8% sooner and 20% bigger per level.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.effect: +1 min blizzard and +15 s attack warning per level; shoots arrows from Lv 5.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.effect: Opens Guarding; +15% guard strength per level. Gear is crafted here.
